author: Creature2589
body:
Hi, I was banned by Diamond/ Penguizz on March 22, 2014 2:43:24GMT

My Minecraft Username: Creature2589 

Reason for Ban: Advertising another server to get more people to join it. I did not receive a warning from Penguizz and was just automatically banned.  
 

The server I was advertising was sr-sg.net which has now been offline for a good two yeaI decided to get back on minecraft after being off it since my ban which was in 2014. I was looking forward to going back to this server but then once I logged on.... I forgot I got banned and was really disappointed. The reason I think I should be un banned is because I would like to play with my friends again and even maybe donate to the server to get a rank. I remember how much fun I would have playing with my brother and would really like to start playing again! Thanks to anyone that helps me out with this :)!
